_comment: Synthetic corpus for the Cairn benchmark harness (scripts/bench.py). Fictional project 'Harbor', an order-fulfilment platform. No real user memories. Keys are stable fixture ids; the server assigns the real memory ids at load time. Each record is a /remember body (SaveInput) plus `key`.

memories.title: Use Postgres SKIP LOCKED for the job queue
memories.summary: Background jobs run from a jobs table claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED instead of Redis or RabbitMQ.
memories.reason: One datastore to operate, and enqueueing is transactional with the order write.
